df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
key=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
drop=set()
for _,grp in df.groupby(key):
    if len(grp)<2: continue
    idx=list(grp.index)
    kept=[]
    for i in idx:
        dup=False
        for k in kept:
            if abs(df.at[i,'bmi']-df.at[k,'bmi'])<=0.2 and abs(df.at[i,'diabetes_pedigree']-df.at[k,'diabetes_pedigree'])<=0.01:
                dup=True;break
        if dup: drop.add(i)
        else: kept.append(i)
print('to drop:',len(drop))
d=df.loc[sorted(drop)]
print('outcome disagreement with a kept twin is possible; dropped outcome counts:', d.outcome.value_counts().to_dict())
print(d.head(10).to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, itertools
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
key=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
rows=[]
for _,g in df.groupby(key):
    if len(g)<2: continue
    for i,j in itertools.combinations(g.index,2):
        rows.append((abs(df.at[i,'bmi']-df.at[j,'bmi']), abs(df.at[i,'diabetes_pedigree']-df.at[j,'diabetes_pedigree']), df.at[i,'outcome']==df.at[j,'outcome']))
p=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['db','dp','same'])

print(np.histogram(p.db,bins=[0,0.001,0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.3,0.5,1,5,100]))
print(np.histogram(p.dp,bins=[0,0.001,0.003,0.005,0.01,0.02,0.05,0.1,1,5]))

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
key=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
drop=set()
for _,g in df.groupby(key):
    if len(g)<2: continue
    kept=[]
    for i in g.index:
        if any(abs(df.at[i,'bmi']-df.at[k,'bmi'])<=0.3 and abs(df.at[i,'diabetes_pedigree']-df.at[k,'diabetes_pedigree'])<=0.02 and df.at[i,'outcome']==df.at[k,'outcome'] for k in kept):
            drop.add(i)
        else: kept.append(i)
clean=df.drop(index=sorted(drop)).reset_index(drop=True)
print(len(drop), clean.shape, clean.outcome.value_counts().to_dict())
clean.to_csv('deduped_tmp.csv',index=False)
"
